title: Oracle: a restricted user needs about 45 more views; exploration finds no tables

found.by: expected-entry test round 2026-10-25: Oracle Free 23.26.3, restricted user with SELECT on ten tables

symptom: CDC_NOT_ENABLED requires SELECT on GV_$INSTANCE, GV_$SESSION and DBA_SEGMENTS for the setup-guide grants; a restricted user needs about 45 more views. With SELECT on ten tables only, Schema Exploration says "Found 0 table(s)" and the update stays INITIALIZING with no event for more than 10 minutes.
cause: The restricted user's grants lacked the views the connector reads; the manual grant list was incomplete.
effect: Exploration finds no tables and the update waits silently.
fix: Grant the full list (the validator's objects), then check that exploration finds the tables.
notes: The rerun with the full list isn't recorded. The all-visible user found 4,500 tables in 6.95 s.
